title: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link - Level Up
description:
The Level Up Fanfare from Zelda 2 on the NES.

Can be used in short celebratory cutscenes.

It can also be used a global song comfortably, since the samples are rather light-weight, though that requires some music knowledge.

Update: Reduced insert size, improved accuracy.
